walletHealth.title: Wallet Health
walletHealth.tooltipHomeDomain: A domain set on your account that links it to a SEP-0001 stellar.toml file. Used by wallets and exchanges to verify your identity.
walletHealth.tooltipSigners: Additional signers that can authorize transactions on your account. Used for multi-signature security. Each non-master signer costs 0.5 XLM reserve.
walletHealth.tooltipSpendableBalance: The amount you can actually send. Stellar requires a minimum reserve of 0.5 XLM per subentry (trustlines, signers, offers, etc.) plus a 1 XLM base reserve.
walletHealth.tooltipTotalBalance: The total XLM balance in your account, including all locked reserves.
walletHealth.tooltipTrustlines: Trustlines allow your account to hold non-XLM assets. Each trustline costs 0.5 XLM as a reserve that cannot be spent.
walletHealth.warningLowSpendable: Low spendable balance — your account is close to the minimum reserve.
walletHealth.warningManySigners: High number of signers ({count}) — review if all are still needed.
walletHealth.warningManyTrustlines: High number of trustlines ({count}) — each locks 0.5 XLM in reserve.
walletHealth.warningMasterWeightZero: Master key weight is 0 — your account may require all signers for transactions.

landing.accountSecurityIntro: Learn more about account security and the network in the
landing.confirmationSpeedExplainer: Stellar transactions typically confirm in just a few seconds, which is why it feels much faster than a bank transfer.
landing.connectWalletAria: Connect wallet to start sending payments
landing.featureInstantSettlementDesc: Stellar transactions confirm in 3–5 seconds. No waiting for bank transfers.
landing.featureMicroFeesDesc: Each transaction costs ~0.00001 XLM. Send $0.01 or $1,000 for the same fee.
landing.featureNonCustodialDesc: Your keys, your funds. We never touch your private key.
landing.featureTrulyGlobalDesc: Send XLM to anyone with a Stellar address, anywhere in the world.
landing.feesExplainer: Fees are tiny—usually a fraction of a cent. That makes Stellar useful for small payments where a bank transfer would be expensive or too slow.
landing.heroSubtitle: Stellar MicroPay lets anyone send tiny payments across borders instant — for fractions of a cent. No bank. No borders. No friction.
landing.readTransactionFlow: Read about transaction flow in the
landing.safetyExplainer: Stellar uses public-key cryptography, so only the owner of a wallet can sign transactions from it. As with any blockchain app, keeping your recovery phrase and private keys secure is essential.
landing.stellarNetworkExplainer: Stellar is an open blockchain network for moving money quickly and with very low fees. It's designed for payments, remittances, and cross-border transfers that settle faster than traditional bank systems.
landing.testnetOpenSourceBadge: Built on Stellar Testnet · Open Source
landing.viewSourceAria: View Stellar-MicroPay source code on GitHub
landing.whatIsStellarIntro: A quick explainer for newcomers, with links to the official Stellar docs.
landing.xlmNativeAssetExplainer: XLM is Stellar's native asset. It's used to pay transaction fees and can also be sent directly like any other digital currency.

rejected.recovery: Try again and approve the request on your device when you are ready.

usbPermissionDenied.message: The browser could not access your Ledger over USB.
usbPermissionDenied.recovery: Select your Ledger in the browser's USB prompt and allow access. Close Ledger Live or other tabs that may be using the device, then try again.

timeout.recovery: Make sure the device is awake and the Stellar app is open, then try again.

unknown.recovery: Reconnect your Ledger, open the Stellar app, and try again.
